breaks.quote: Melina saw through hers in 3 sessions. It took me years to see through mine.
breaks.why: The health case and his own sentence end there, and nothing carries the idea into the reader's other areas of life, so the reader is left to apply it alone.

breaks.quote: He didn't need more options. He needed the focus to stick with what he picked.
breaks.why: The passage closes on David alone and never turns to the reader's own areas of life, so the reader does not see where this lands for them.
